name: multi-01-same-header-ladder
description: Three files with the *same* header (`import Mathlib`), opened one at a time and each allowed to settle before the next: the ladder that answers 'what does the 2nd and the 3rd simultaneously-open file cost?' with no contention confound. A memory probe after each step gives the incremental resident size and the incremental private footprint. The primary file's edits, completion and `exact?` then run with all three workers alive.
